case: F05 smart canvas native pointer drag of video and audio from asset library

uiResult.assetPanel: Opened the asset library on an initially empty smart canvas.
uiResult.method: Native pointer drag from the visible audio card onto the canvas, followed by a separate native pointer drag of the video card.

validation: Re-read the isolated canvas and asset-library JSON; verified both isolated media file sizes and SHA-256 hashes. The browser rendered and decoded both media elements after refresh.
limits: This covers self-made short WAV/WebM files and the smart canvas asset-library drag path in the in-app browser. No generation button, paid provider, production data, or independent browser profile was exercised. The ordinary-canvas image output drag was verified separately; this case does not test ordinary-canvas audio/video. Stage 3 remains in progress.
